name: SteelSeries QCK Prism
description: The two lights of the SteelSeries QCK Prism Cloth mouse mats (Medium, XL and its editions, 3XL, 4XL, 5XL). Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesQCKMatController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Every colour report is followed by OpenRGB's report 0x0D, whose function is unknown: it may store the colours in the mat's memory. HueDeck therefore sends colours only when they change and at most once a second (an animated effect looks stepped), and a black Shutdown may persist as the mat's stored state. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-qck.md.
